facts.question: Was the room E door held open on the incident night?
facts.answer: yes: held fully open for several hours (controller link drops whenever that door is fully open; trips and a lockout follow in the fault snapshot; a rubber wedge was bought and photographed under that door two weeks earlier)

trap_claims.text: all the rooms were closed and nobody went near room E after that

When was the door closed (true UTC)?

Did room E exceed its product limit?
facts.answer: yes, from about 2026-06-20T01:08:00Z until about 2026-06-20T09:52:00Z (recovery curve after the link returned; lab result)

facts.question: Was unit VX05 flashed to firmware 3.4 during the vendor visit?
facts.answer: yes, on 2026-06-08T15:02:00Z: its readings decode about 19 C lower from then on, the invoice bills two units, and the technician's badge opened room E

trap_claims.text: Unit VX05 (room E): inspected only, no changes made

facts.question: Which other unit was flashed?
Why did the flashed rooms read about -40 C?
facts.answer: the gateway decoder assumes the firmware-3.2 delta encoding; firmware 3.4 sends absolute temperatures (flagged in the status word), so the decoded value equals true temperature plus the setpoint

trap_claims.text: The vendor confirmed by phone that the -40 readings are a known sensor fault on the 3.4 boards

facts.question: Were the -40 readings a sensor fault?
facts.answer: no: handheld probe checks on those rooms agree with the true temperatures; the raw frames decode correctly under the 3.4 format

trap_claims.text: The vendor confirmed by phone that the -40 readings are a known sensor fault on the 3.4 boards

facts.question: What did the hotfix commit change?
facts.answer: commit 761f81a routed rooms C/E low-temperature alerts to #alerts-coldchain-old, a channel the manager then archived

facts.question: When was #alerts-coldchain-old archived relative to the incident?

trap_claims.text: I archived the old alert channel only after the incident

facts.question: Was a minimum-severity override active during the incident?
facts.answer: yes: deploy/config.override.json sets ALERT_MIN_SEVERITY=critical; the alerting log shows warnings suppressed from 2026-06-10T02:27:00Z onward and it is still present in the deployed tree

facts.question: Was the override reverted?
facts.answer: no: the file is still in the deployed tree and suppression continues to the end of the logs

facts.question: Did the VX05 compressor fail?
facts.answer: no: it cooled normally before and after the lockout; the lockout is the controller's trip-count rule; the recall notice covers a different compressor model

trap_claims.text: Root cause: compressor failure on controller VX05

facts.question: Why does the ledger disagree with physical pallet positions?
facts.answer: the gateway retries the dispatch webhook after a timeout and dispatch applies moves without checking the current position, so a delayed duplicate of an earlier move overwrites a later move (dispatch log 'zone mismatch' warnings)

facts.question: Which lots were physically in room E during the excursion (those the surviving records establish)?
Was the quarantine list correct?
facts.answer: no: it was taken from the corrupted ledger; it includes lots that were not in the room and omits some that were

facts.question: What happened to the room D sensor?
facts.answer: its reading drifted upward by about 3.2 C between 2026-06-12 and 2026-06-26 (handheld checks diverge from the panel), and was recalibrated on 2026-06-27

facts.question: What happened during the generator test?
facts.answer: site power was off from 2026-06-07T10:58:00Z to 2026-06-07T11:25:00Z: every controller rebooted (sequence and clock reset), the gateway host rebooted and its logs rotated

facts.question: Why are there no service logs for a window after the incident?
facts.answer: the gateway host disk was full from 2026-06-20T12:00:00Z to 2026-06-20T15:00:00Z; services kept running (the ledger database has readings for the window) but nothing was appended to the log files

facts.question: Why are there no badge records for the room E reader that week?
facts.answer: the reader was offline from 2026-06-16 to 2026-06-21 (facilities ticket); doors were opened with the key

facts.question: Why does the forklift telematics have a gap for FL-2?
facts.answer: its telematics battery failed; no trail from 2026-06-20 to 2026-06-22 although the scanner kept posting moves

facts.question: How are defrosts scheduled?
facts.answer: by compressor runtime (about every R runtime-hours, inside fixed daily windows, one room at a time in a fixed priority order), not every 6 hours as the runbook says

facts.question: Is the clerk's handheld accurate?
facts.answer: no: HH-2 reads +0.8 C high per the calibration certificate, so the clerk's sheet overstates

trap_claims.text: My handheld was calibrated last month and reads fine

facts.question: Was the room E door held open on earlier nights?
facts.answer: yes: the controller link dropped on 9 earlier nights during the night shift, each with trips in the snapshot-style pattern

facts.answer: Maya Mensah on 2026-06-08 (receipt submitted for reimbursement; photo posted in chat the same night)

facts.question: Is the night lead's statement that nobody went near the room after the walk-through true?

facts.answer: badge -7 min, exif -120 min, cctv -4 min

facts.supported: it was deployed at about 2026-06-10T02:27:00Z (alerting log) as an untracked file
facts.why_undeterminable: the file is untracked (no author, uniform mtimes), both engineers deny it in statements and chat, both were on call with deploy access

facts.question: What peak temperature did room E reach?

near or above 0 C (the door stood open for hours; the recovery curve is consistent with either)

facts.question: Did the technician knowingly misreport which units were flashed?

facts.why_undeterminable: intent is not recoverable from these records

facts.question: What is the single root cause of the missed alarm?
facts.answer: there is no single cause: the alarm was independently prevented by (1) the decoder's delta assumption after the 3.4 flash (readings never crossed the high limit), (2) the routing hotfix to an archived channel, (3) the minimum-severity override, and (4) the link loss while the door was open; removing any one alone would not have raised a page

trap_claims.text: Root cause: compressor failure on controller VX05

facts.question: Which lots should be quarantined according to the ledger?
facts.answer: the ledger cannot answer it: its positions were corrupted by the dispatch race; the physical positions must be rebuilt from the inventory import, the forklift telematics and the scanner lines, and for the disk-full window they cannot be rebuilt at all
